summary.zh-CN: 界定希望玩家获得的体验，并分析玩家如何理解、感受与赋予行动意义。
summary.en: Frame intended experiences and examine how players understand, feel, and give meaning to action.

summary.zh-CN: 处理行动、规则、反馈、挑战、节奏与成长如何构成可持续的游玩系统。
summary.en: Shape actions, rules, feedback, challenge, pacing, and progression into sustainable play systems.

summary.zh-CN: 处理拓扑、路线、尺度、导航、遭遇和空间验证，关注玩家如何穿行并读取空间。
summary.en: Work with topology, routes, scale, navigation, encounters, and spatial validation.

summary.zh-CN: 协调故事、世界、角色、信息揭示与视听表现，使表达回应玩家行动和体验意图。
summary.en: Coordinate story, world, character, exposition, and audiovisual expression around player action and experience intent.

summary.zh-CN: 把设计疑问转成可观察证据，并谨慎解释行为、访谈与遥测数据。
summary.en: Turn design questions into observable evidence and interpret behavioral, interview, and telemetry data carefully.

summary.zh-CN: 用合适的原型、范围、任务与交接方式降低不确定性，组织可执行的迭代。
summary.en: Reduce uncertainty through suitable prototypes, scope, tasks, handoffs, and executable iterations.

summary.zh-CN: 建立跨专业共同理解，在约束中做取舍，并维护可讨论、可调整的创意方向。
summary.en: Build shared understanding, make tradeoffs under constraints, and steward a discussable creative direction.

summary.zh-CN: 理解受众、市场、价值交换、商业模式及其文化伦理后果。
summary.en: Understand audiences, markets, value exchange, business models, and their cultural and ethical consequences.
